checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'rtk rg -n "webServer|BASE_URL|API|settings-and-audit|settings-privilege|release-policy|monitoring|network" frontend/playwright*.ts frontend/tests/helpers frontend/tests/*.spec.ts scripts/run-e2e.sh | head -280'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,240p' frontend/playwright.config.ts 2>/dev/null; rtk sed -n '1,220p' frontend/playwright.v1.config.ts 2>/dev/null; rtk sed -n '1,180p' scripts/run-e2e.sh"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk bash scripts/run-e2e.sh --config=playwright.v1.config.ts tests/settings-and-audit.spec.ts tests/settings-standards.spec.ts tests/release-policy-normal.spec.ts tests/release-policy-root-preview.spec.ts tests/monitoring-workflows.spec.ts tests/network-workflows.spec.ts'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,180p' frontend/tests/settings-and-audit.spec.ts && rtk sed -n '1,220p' frontend/tests/helpers/sysgrid.ts | head -40"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,120p' frontend/src/components/settings/SystemDiagnosticsPanel.tsx && rtk rg -n \"runSystemDiagnostics|settings/startup|user/env|diagnostic\" frontend/src/components/settings frontend/src/api | head -160"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,120p' frontend/src/components/shared/TenantSelector.tsx && rtk rg -n \"tenants/|tenants\" frontend/src/components/shared frontend/src/App.tsx | head -120"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk nl -ba backend/test_system_management_v1_policy.py | sed -n '95,165p'
rtk git diff --check
rtk git status --short --branch"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git diff --stat
rtk git diff -- backend/app/api/authorization.py backend/app/api/module_policy.py frontend/src/policy/ModulePolicy.tsx frontend/src/components/Settings.tsx
rtk git diff -- backend/test_chg13_authorization_security.py backend/test_system_management_v1_policy.py frontend/src/components/shared/NetworkAuditTypedLinksContract.test.ts frontend/tests/settings-and-audit.spec.ts'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,240p' frontend/src/components/settings/settingsPrivilegePolicy.ts
rtk sed -n '1,280p' frontend/src/components/settings/settingsPrivilegePolicy.test.ts
rtk sed -n '1,360p' frontend/tests/settings-privilege.spec.ts
rtk rg -n \"userProfile\\?\\.is_admin|/api/v1/settings/global|/api/v1/settings/env/history|user-pool/versions|tenants/admin|diagnostics\" frontend/src/components/Settings.tsx"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk rg -n \"enabled: globalConfigManage|Analysis|tab === 'system'|requires global\" frontend/src/components/Settings.tsx frontend/src/components/settings/settingsPrivilegePolicy.ts frontend/src/components/settings/settingsPrivilegePolicy.test.ts
rtk git diff --check"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,180p' frontend/src/policy/ModulePolicy.tsx
rtk sed -n '130,270p' backend/app/api/module_policy.py
rtk sed -n '120,185p' backend/app/api/authorization.py"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk bash scripts/run-e2e.sh --config=playwright.config.ts tests/settings-privilege.spec.ts tests/settings-and-audit.spec.ts tests/settings-standards.spec.ts tests/release-policy-normal.spec.ts tests/release-policy-root-preview.spec.ts tests/monitoring-workflows.spec.ts tests/network-workflows.spec.ts'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,120p' frontend/tests/release-policy-root-preview.spec.ts
rtk rg -n \"root-v1|SYSTEM_ROOT|system_root|SYSGRID_VERIFY_PROFILE|ROOT\" frontend/tests frontend/playwright* scripts backend/app | head -200
rtk git diff -- backend/app/api/module_policy.py backend/app/api/authorization.py"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk env SYSGRID_VERIFY_PROFILE=root-preview SYSGRID_VERIFY_SYSTEM_ROOT_USER_ID=haewon.kim SYSGRID_VERIFY_USER_ID=haewon.kim USER_ID=haewon.kim bash scripts/run-e2e.sh --config=playwright.config.ts tests/release-policy-root-preview.spec.ts'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git rev-parse HEAD
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^{tree}
rtk git rev-parse main
rtk git status --porcelain=v1
rtk git diff --name-only
rtk git diff --numstat -- frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx contracts/system_management_v1.json
rtk git hash-object frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx
rtk git rev-parse d5fe0e5d5b92fcd1d9e33f4689a362e9c5946aac:frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx
rtk git hash-object contracts/system_management_v1.json
rtk git rev-parse d5fe0e5d5b92fcd1d9e33f4689a362e9c5946aac:contracts/system_management_v1.json
rtk git diff --check'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git log --oneline --decorate -4 --all --simplify-by-decoration
rtk git branch -vv
rtk git remote -v
rtk git diff --name-only --no-renames
rtk git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
rtk git diff -- frontend/src/components/shared/NetworkAuditTypedLinksContract.test.ts'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git branch --show-current
rtk git rev-parse refs/heads/main
rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main
rtk git log --oneline --decorate -6 HEAD
rtk git log --oneline --decorate -6 refs/heads/main
rtk git merge-base HEAD refs/heads/main
rtk git status --porcelain=v1 -uno
rtk git diff --quiet -- frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx contracts/system_management_v1.json'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git add backend/app/api/authorization.py backend/app/api/module_policy.py backend/test_chg13_authorization_security.py backend/test_system_management_v1_policy.py frontend/src/components/Settings.tsx frontend/src/components/shared/NetworkAuditTypedLinksContract.test.ts frontend/src/components/settings/settingsPrivilegePolicy.ts frontend/src/components/settings/settingsPrivilegePolicy.test.ts frontend/src/policy/ModulePolicy.tsx frontend/tests/settings-and-audit.spec.ts frontend/tests/settings-privilege.spec.ts
rtk git diff --cached --check
rtk git diff --cached --name-only'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git commit -m "feat: converge settings privilege authority"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git rev-parse HEAD
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^1
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^{tree}
rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main
rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/codex/sysgrid-smv1-settings-privilege-authority-v1
rtk git status --porcelain=v1 --branch
rtk git diff --quiet HEAD''^ -- frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx contracts/system_management_v1.json
rtk git hash-object frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^:frontend/src/components/Racks.tsx
rtk git hash-object contracts/system_management_v1.json
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^:contracts/system_management_v1.json
rtk git show --stat --oneline --summary HEAD'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git ls-remote --heads origin codex/sysgrid-smv1-settings-privilege-authority-v1
rtk git ls-remote --heads origin project-os-artifacts/sysgrid/sysgrid-smv1-settings-privilege-authority-v1
rtk git ls-remote --heads origin codex-fabric/evidence/sysgrid/sysgrid-smv1-settings-privilege-authority-v1'
